description: This file contains utility functions related to string processing, specifically for manipulating textual representations of numbers—removing leading zeros and explicit plus signs, and validating characters in string representations based on radix.

methods.name: removeLeadingZerosAndExplicitPlus
methods.description: Removes leading zeros and explicit plus signs from a string representation of a number.

methods.name: validateStringCharacters
methods.description: Validates if a string contains only valid characters for a given radix; returns false if invalid.
